title: SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations
title_zh: SAGE：基于视觉基础表示的显著因素发现与生成

paragraphs.en: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates salient factors specific to the target from common content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. On Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ eyeglasses, SAGE combines high-fidelity reconstruction (rFID below 2 2 ) with unsupervised subtype discovery , recovering the digits better than baselines (probe accuracy 0.950 0.950 vs. at most 0.281 0.281 ) and revealing eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and mislabeled images; salient-conditioned generation raises Digits-ImageNet subtype accuracy over the unfactorized latent ( 90.5 % 90.5\% vs. 27.7 % 27.7\% ) and diversity on both datasets. On retinal OCT, SAGE’s salient space separates three diseases using only normal/disease labels.

paragraphs.en: Learning what two data distributions share and what sets one apart is central to multimodal learning ( Dufumier et al., 2025 ) , domain adaptation ( Lee et al., 2021 ) , and disentanglement ( Sanchez et al., 2020 ) . Contrastive analysis (CA) poses this problem with dataset labels alone: given a target and a background dataset, it separates salient factors z s z_{s} specific to the target from common factors z c z_{c} shared by both. For faces with and without eyeglasses as target and background (Fig. 1 ), z s z_{s} should capture eyewear-related variation (e.g., frame style and color) and z c z_{c} the content both groups share (e.g., identity, pose, and scene). The stakes are especially high in medicine, where clinical group labels may be available even when the corresponding imaging differences remain unknown. Autism, for instance, is diagnosed from behavior, which tells us who is affected but not how their brains differ; contrasting brain MRI of the autism and control groups can reveal these differences ( Aglinskas et al., 2022 ) . Such patterns are subtle, hard to describe in words, and not known in advance, yet finding them could provide objective imaging markers, deepen the understanding of a disease, and even uncover its subtypes. paragraphs.en: Can we learn salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, reveal subtypes without labels, and generate new examples of what they discover?
paragraphs.zh: 我们能否学会生成显著表示，以捕捉每张图像中针对特定目标的细节、无需标签地揭示亚型，并生成其所发现内容的新示例？

paragraphs.en: Answering it requires a representation that is semantically rich enough for discovery and decodable back to images, and existing CA methods offer complementary strengths toward these goals: generative CA models ( Abid and Zou, 2019 ; Louiset et al., 2023 ; Carton et al., 2024 ) decode their factors but reconstruct complex natural images poorly, and contrastive CA methods ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) learn semantically rich factors but have no decoder. In this work, we propose SAGE ( Sa lient factor discovery and Ge neration), a contrastive analysis approach that factorizes the frozen spatial latent z z of a representation autoencoder (RAE), RAEv2 ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , into z c z_{c} and z s z_{s} , whose sum the frozen RAE decoder maps back to images. Built on a pretrained foundation encoder, DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , this latent is semantically rich, keeps a high-dimensional spatial layout in which salient factors can retain instance-level detail such as the shape, color, and position of a particular pair of glasses, decodes with high fidelity, and supports state-of-the-art diffusion generation ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 要回答这个问题，需要一个在语义上足够丰富、足以支持特征发现并能解码回图像的表示形式。现有的对比分析（CA）方法在这些目标上具有互补的优势：生成式 CA 模型（Abid and Zou, 2019；Louiset et al., 2023；Carton et al., 2024）虽然能够解码其因子，但重建复杂自然图像的效果不佳；而对比式 CA 方法（Louiset et al., 2024）虽能学习到语义丰富的因子，却缺乏解码器。 在本项工作中，我们提出了 SAGE（语义丰富因子发现与生成），这是一种对比分析方法，它将表示自编码器（RAE）——RAEv2（Singh et al., 2026）——中冻结的空间潜在变量 z z 分解为 z c z_{c} 和 z s z_{s}，而冻结的 RAE 解码器可将它们的和映射回图像。 该方法基于预训练的基础编码器 DINOv3（Siméoni et al., 2025）构建。该潜在表示在语义上十分丰富，保留了高维空间布局，使得关键因子能够维持实例级别的细节，例如特定眼镜的形状、颜色和位置；它具备高保真度的解码能力，并支持当前最先进的扩散生成技术（Zheng et al., 2026；Singh et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: This latent, however, mixes target-specific variation with all other image content ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Separating the two is nontrivial: reconstruction alone is already satisfied by an empty z s z_{s} , a high-dimensional z s z_{s} can easily absorb shared content, and it can capture only a generic template of the attribute while instance-specific detail stays in z c z_{c} . SAGE counters these failures with objectives that include swapping salient factors between background and target images, keeping them sparse, and requiring them to be recoverable after the swap. The learned salient factors cleanly separate target-specific content and reveal subtypes, and they can be swapped or removed to edit individual images. SAGE can further generate images. Because the salient variation is often not known in advance and has no name or text description, instruction- or prompt-conditioned generation ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) cannot even be applied; instead, in a second stage, SAGE conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image to generate new images that keep its salient subtype while their common content varies. This in turn indicates that the salient condition carries little of the reference’s shared content.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种潜在变量将目标特定的变化与其他所有图像内容混合在一起（Li et al., 2023）。 将两者分离并非易事：仅通过重建这一条件就已经被一个空的 z_s z_{s} 满足；高维的 z_s z_{s} 很容易吸收共享内容，并且只能捕捉属性的通用模板，而实例特定的细节仍保留在 z_c z_{c} 中。 SAGE 通过一系列目标来应对这些失败，包括在背景和目标图像之间交换显著因素、保持它们的稀疏性，并要求它们在交换后能够被恢复。 学习到的显著因素能够清晰地分离出目标特定的内容并揭示其亚型，同时还可以被交换或移除以编辑单张图像。 SAGE 还可以进一步生成图像。 由于显著变化通常无法提前知晓，且没有名称或文本描述，因此基于指令或提示的条件生成（Liu et al., 2023; Wu et al., 2025）甚至无法应用；取而代之的是，在第二阶段，SAGE 将扩散变换器以参考图像中已学习的显著表示为条件，生成新的图像，这些图像保留其显著的亚型，而共同内容则发生变化。 这反过来表明，显著条件几乎不包含参考图像的共享内容。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions answer each part of the question above: (1) Learning clean, high-fidelity salient factors : salient factors decode to only the digit or eyeglasses, and together with the common factors they reconstruct Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ images with rFID below 2 2 , versus above 120 120 for generative CA baselines. (2) Revealing subtypes without labels : on Digits-ImageNet, the salient space recovers the ten digits far better than a contrastive CA baseline on the same encoder (probe accuracy 0.950 0.950 vs. 0.148 0.148 ); on FFHQ, it separates eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and a mislabeled cluster; and on retinal OCT, it distinguishes three diseases. (3) Generating what is discovered : on Digits-ImageNet, conditioning on a reference’s salient representation, without text prompts or subtype labels, preserves its subtype far more often and produces more varied samples than the unfactorized latent (subtype accuracy 90.5 % 90.5\% vs. 27.7 % 27.7\% ; Vendi 12.50 12.50 vs. 2.65 2.65 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献回答了上述问题的每个部分：(1) 学习干净、高保真的显著因素：显著因素仅解码为数字或眼镜，并与共同因素一起重建 Digits-ImageNet 和 FFHQ 图像，其 rFID 低于 2.2，而生成式 CA 基线模型则高于 120.120。 (2) 无需标签揭示亚型：在 Digits-ImageNet 上，显著空间恢复十个数字的效果远优于在同一编码器上的对比性 CA 基线模型（探测准确率为 0.950 对比 0.148）；在 FFHQ 上，它能区分眼镜类型、更精细的太阳镜款式以及一个被错误标记的簇；而在视网膜 OCT 上，它能区分三种疾病。 (3) 生成已发现的内容：在 Digits-ImageNet 上，以参考样本的显著表示为条件（无需文本提示或亚型标签），比未因子化的潜在空间更频繁地保留其亚型，并生成更多样化的样本（亚型准确率为 90.5% 对比 27.7%；Vendi 为 12.50 对比 2.65）。

sents.zh: (2) 无需标签揭示亚型：在 Digits-ImageNet 上，显著空间恢复十个数字的效果远优于在同一编码器上的对比性 CA 基线模型（探测准确率为 0.950 对比 0.148）；在 FFHQ 上，它能区分眼镜类型、更精细的太阳镜款式以及一个被错误标记的簇；而在视网膜 OCT 上，它能区分三种疾病。

sents.en: (3) Generating what is discovered : on Digits-ImageNet, conditioning on a reference’s salient representation, without text prompts or subtype labels, preserves its subtype far more often and produces more varied samples than the unfactorized latent (subtype accuracy 90.5 % 90.5\% vs. 27.7 % 27.7\% ; Vendi 12.50 12.50 vs. 2.65 2.65 ).
sents.zh: (3) 生成已发现的内容：在 Digits-ImageNet 上，以参考样本的显著表示为条件（无需文本提示或亚型标签），比未因子化的潜在空间更频繁地保留其亚型，并生成更多样化的样本（亚型准确率为 90.5% 对比 27.7%；Vendi 为 12.50 对比 2.65）。

paragraphs.en: Contrastive analysis (CA) separates factors shared by background and target datasets from target-specific ones using only dataset labels, with applications in neuroimaging ( Aglinskas et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) and disease subgroup discovery ( Louiset et al., 2026 ) . cVAE ( Abid and Zou, 2019 ) , SepVAE ( Louiset et al., 2023 ) , and Double-InfoGAN ( Carton et al., 2024 ) learn the factors with a generator trained from scratch; SepCLR ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) learns strong salient representations under the InfoMax principle but has no decoder, and adding a reconstruction objective weakens its factor separation. CS-StyleGAN ( He et al., 2025 ) separates factors in an inverted StyleGAN latent and refines reconstructions with input features, and the concurrent Diff-CA ( Soumm et al., 2026 ) decomposes compact conditioning tokens of a diffusion generator. These methods represent the salient factor as a low-dimensional vector or global token; SAGE factorizes the full spatial latent of a frozen RAE and uses it for both discovery and generation.
paragraphs.zh: 对比分析（CA）仅利用数据集标签，将背景数据集和目标数据集共有的因素与目标数据集特有的因素区分开来，并应用于神经影像（Aglinskas 等人，2022；Zhu 等人，2026）和疾病亚组发现（Louiset 等人，2026）。cVAE（Abid 和 Zou，2019）、SepVAE（Louiset 等人，2023）以及 Double-InfoGAN（Carton 等人，2024）通过从头训练的生成器来学习这些因素；SepCLR（Louiset 等人，2024）在 InfoMax 原则下能够学习出强而显著的特征表示，但缺乏解码器，且添加重建目标会削弱其对因素分离的能力。 CS-StyleGAN（He 等人，2025）在倒置的 StyleGAN 潜在空间中分离各因素，并利用输入特征优化重建结果；同时提出的 Diff-CA（Soumm 等人，2026）则对扩散生成器的紧凑条件化标记进行分解。 这些方法将显著因素表示为低维向量或全局标记；SAGE 则将冻结 RAE 的完整空间潜在空间进行因子分解，并用于发现与生成两个环节。

paragraphs.en: Recent work replaces the VAE of latent diffusion with frozen pretrained encoders ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) ; RAEs pair such encoders with ViT decoders that match or exceed standard VAEs ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and RAEv2 adds REPA ( Singh et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . SAGE factorizes this latent rather than only generating in it. Representation-conditioned generation ( Li et al., 2024 ) conditions on a full self-supervised representation, and diffusion editing ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) changes prompt-specified attributes; SAGE instead conditions on a discovered salient representation, specifying a subtype by example.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究用冻结的预训练编码器替换了潜在扩散模型中的 VAE（Zheng 等人，2026；Tong 等人，2026；Shi 等人，2026；Gao 等人，2026）；RAE 将此类编码器和 ViT 解码器配对，其性能与标准 VAE 相当甚至更优（Zheng 等人，2026），而 RAEv2 则加入了 REPA（Singh 等人，2026；Yu 等人，2025）。 SAGE 对这一潜在表示进行因子分解，而不仅仅是在此表示空间中进行生成。 表示条件生成（Li 等人，2024）以完整的自监督表示为条件，而扩散编辑（Meng 等人，2022；Wu 等人，2025）则修改提示中指定的属性；相比之下，SAGE 以发现的关键表示为条件，并通过示例指定一个子类型。

paragraphs.en: SAGE needs a latent that is semantically expressive for discovery and decodable for reconstruction, manipulation, and generation. Unlike the VAE latents of standard latent diffusion, which are trained for reconstruction and carry limited semantic structure ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , RAEs pair frozen pretrained visual encoders with trained decoders, providing both properties and supporting high-quality latent diffusion ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) . We use the frozen RAEv2 encoder and decoder ( Singh et al., 2026 ) : E E is DINOv3-L ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) with multi-layer summation (MLS), and D D reconstructs images from z z . We factorize this spatial latent directly, without a learned bottleneck, to retain localized salient content (Fig. 4 ); freezing E E and D D attributes decoded changes to the learned factors and lets Stage 2 reuse RAEv2’s pretrained diffusion transformer.
paragraphs.zh: SAGE 需要一个在语义上具有表现力的潜在变量，以便进行发现；同时该潜在变量必须可解码，以支持重建、操控和生成。 与标准潜在扩散模型中用于重建且仅携带有限语义结构的 VAE 潜在变量不同（Zheng et al., 2026），RAE 将冻结的预训练视觉编码器与训练好的解码器相结合，同时具备上述两种特性，并支持高质量潜在扩散（Zheng et al., 2026；Singh et al., 2026）。 我们使用冻结的 RAEv2 编码器和解码器（Singh et al., 2026）：E E 是 DINOv3-L（Siméoni et al., 2025），并采用多层求和（MLS）；D D 则从 z z 重建图像。 我们直接对这种空间潜在变量进行因子分解，而无需引入可学习的瓶颈层，以保留局部显著内容（图 4）；冻结 E E 和 D D 会将解码后的变化归因于可学习的因子，并使阶段 2 能够复用 RAEv2 的预训练扩散变换器。

paragraphs.en: We first ask whether SAGE isolates a clean salient factor, one that contains the target content and little else, while the two factors together still reconstruct the image.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先想知道，SAGE 是否分离出了一个纯净且显著的因素——该因素包含目标内容而几乎不包含其他信息，同时这两个因素共同仍能重建图像。

paragraphs.en: Among decoder-based methods, only SAGE separates the target attribute cleanly (Fig. 4 ; additional randomly selected examples in Appendix Fig. A.1 ): it reconstructs scenes and faces with their digits or eyeglasses, common-only decoding removes only the target attribute, and salient-only decoding renders the digit or eyeglasses alone at their original location and shape. Generative baselines blur reconstructions and alter the scene or face even in common-only decoding; their salient-only outputs show no recognizable digit on Digits-ImageNet and blurred eyeglasses with much of the face on FFHQ, indicating common-content leakage. At the dataset level, SAGE’s salient t-SNE separates background from target images (Fig. 5 a, d), as the sparsity prior drives background salient factors toward zero; those of cVAE and, on Digits-ImageNet, SepVAE mix the two (Appendix Fig. 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在基于解码器的方法中，只有 SAGE 能够清晰分离目标属性（图 4；更多随机选择的示例见附录图 A.1）：它能重构出带有数字或眼镜的场景和人脸；仅对共同内容解码时，只会移除目标属性；而仅对显著内容解码时，则会在其原始位置和形状上单独呈现数字或眼镜。生成式基线模型的重建结果存在模糊现象，即使在仅对共同内容解码时，场景或人脸也会发生改变；在仅对显著内容解码的输出中，Digits-ImageNet 数据集上无法识别出任何数字，而 FFHQ 数据集上的眼镜则显得模糊不清，且大部分人脸也一同呈现，这表明存在共同内容的泄露。在数据集层面，SAGE 的显著性 t-SNE 能够将背景与目标图像区分开来（图 5a、d），因为稀疏性先验会将背景的显著性因子推向零；而 cVAE 以及 Digits-ImageNet 数据集上的 SepVAE 则使两者混合在一起（附录图 10）。

paragraphs.en: SAGE achieves rFID 1.78 1.78 on Digits-ImageNet and 1.65 1.65 on FFHQ, whereas generative baselines trained from scratch exceed 120 120 (Table 1 ), because SAGE factorizes a frozen RAEv2 latent and decodes it with the pretrained decoder, adding little error over decoding z z directly ( 1.78 1.78 versus 0.39 0.39 on Digits-ImageNet). Its salient space also separates background from target images best among all methods (silhouette 0.820 0.820 and 0.873 0.873 ). Linear probes (Appendix A.9 ) show that digit identity is far more accessible in z s z_{s} than in z z ( 0.950 0.950 versus 0.328 0.328 ), while ImageNet category, a property of the shared scene, is readily decoded from z z and z c z_{c} ( 0.765 0.765 ) but hardly from z s z_{s} ( 0.045 0.045 ). SepCLR and DINOv3 + SepCLR lack decoders; their comparison follows.

paragraphs.en: We next ask whether the salient factor discovers target subtypes without subtype labels, both the expected ten digits and two eyewear types and groups we did not expect.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们想知道：在没有子类型标签的情况下，显著因子能否发现目标子类型——既包括我们预期的十个数字，也包括我们未曾预料到的两种眼镜类型和分组。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows t-SNE ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) of salient representations, colored by dataset label and, for targets, subtype labels used only for visualization. Background–target separation (Fig. 5 a, d; Section 4.2 ) does not imply subtype separation: SepCLR and DINOv3 + SepCLR also separate the datasets, yet their target digits remain mixed (Appendix A.3 ). SAGE recovers the expected subtypes: the ten digit identities form locally coherent, partly overlapping groups, and reading glasses and sunglasses form two separate groups (Fig. 5 b, e); raw z z separates neither (Fig. 5 c, f). Samples from each group (Fig. 5 g, h) share the digit or eyewear type while their scenes and faces differ, so the grouping follows the target attribute rather than shared content.

paragraphs.en: Because both factors live in the latent space of the frozen decoder, the salient factor can be moved between images, removed, or interpolated, and the result decoded directly. We test whether such edits change only the target attribute. Swapping and erasure. Adding a target image’s salient factor to a background image transfers its particular attribute (Fig. 6 , left): a digit 7 retains its location and stroke shape, and thick black frames, rather than generic glasses, appear on a new face while the scene and identity remain. Conversely, zeroing a target’s salient factor removes the digit or reading glasses while preserving the rest (Fig. 6 , right; more in Fig. 14 ). These edits illustrate that each salient factor carries its own image’s target attribute and little else. Interpolation. Interpolating salient factors of two target images while retaining the first common factor changes mainly the target attribute (Fig. 7 , salient-only rows): a digit turns from 1 to 7 on a fixed photograph, and clear reading glasses darken into sunglasses on a fixed face. Interpolating both factors cross-fades the whole image (full-latent rows). Salient interpolation thus traverses subtypes while preserving common content.
paragraphs.zh: 由于这两个因子都存在于冻结解码器的潜在空间中，显著因子可以在不同图像之间移动、移除或进行插值，其结果也能直接解码。 我们测试此类编辑是否仅改变目标属性。替换与擦除。 将目标图像的显著因子添加到背景图像中，会转移其特定属性（图6，左侧）：数字7保持其位置和笔画形状，而新的面孔上则出现了粗黑边框而非普通眼镜，同时场景和身份特征保持不变。 相反，将目标图像的显著因子归零，则会移除该数字或老花镜，但保留其余部分（图6，右侧；更多细节见图14）。 这些编辑表明，每个显著因子仅携带其所在图像的目标属性，几乎不包含其他信息。插值。 在保留第一个共同因子的同时，对两个目标图像的显著因子进行插值，主要改变的是目标属性（图7，仅显著因子行）：在一张固定的照片中，数字从1变为7；在一张固定的面孔上，透明老花镜逐渐变暗成为太阳镜。 对两个因子同时进行插值，则会使整张图像交叉淡出（全潜在因子行）。 因此，显著因子的插值能够在保留共同内容的同时，遍历不同的子类型。

paragraphs.en: Unlike digits and eyeglasses, retinal disease subtypes are clinically subtle and vary across patients. On OCT-Kermany, SAGE is trained only with normal/disease labels. Disease subtypes. Its salient space separates the three diseases, with t-SNE groups that overlap mainly at their boundaries (Fig. 8 , left), a linear-probe accuracy of 0.960 0.960 , and ARI/NMI 0.415 / 0.415 0.415/0.415 (Appendix A.7 ). Disease-specific edits. Adding a disease scan’s salient factor to a normal scan introduces fluid-filled cavities, while removing it yields a retina closer to normal (Fig. 8 , middle and right), suggesting disease-related features rather than patient-specific anatomy. These edits are qualitative, not clinical evidence.

paragraphs.en: Representation-conditioned generation ( Li et al., 2024 ) conditions on a full self-supervised representation; we instead condition on SAGE’s pooled salient representation c s c_{s} . Raw DINOv3 GMP pools the unfactorized latent z z identically, testing whether factorization removes reference face or scene information. Qualitative results. Salient conditioning generates new faces and scenes that keep the reference digit or eyewear type, whereas Raw DINOv3 GMP reproduces the reference person or scene almost exactly and often changes the digit (Appendix Fig. 15 ); Fig. 3 (top right) shows several samples per reference. Quantitative results. On Digits-ImageNet, salient conditioning raises subtype accuracy from 27.7 % 27.7\% to 90.5 % 90.5\% and Vendi from 2.65 2.65 to 12.50 12.50 (real: 15.79 15.79 ), and lowers Cos-to-ref from 0.794 0.794 to 0.116 0.116 (Table 2 ). On FFHQ, both conditions preserve eyewear type ( 96.6 % 96.6\% versus 98.5 % 98.5\% ), but only salient conditioning produces varied samples (Vendi 6.96 6.96 versus 2.32 2.32 ; Cos-to-ref 0.470 0.470 versus 0.779 0.779 ). Since the two conditions differ only in the salient encoder, reduced copying supports z s z_{s} as a more selective condition. Raw DINOv3 GMP attains lower conditional gFID, consistent with closer reference copying rather than subtype control, while SAGE has lower unconditional gFID on both datasets.
paragraphs.zh: Representation-conditioned generation (Li et al., 2024) 以完整的自监督表示为条件；而我们的方法则以 SAGE 的池化显著表示 c_s c_{s} 为条件。 Raw DINOv3 GMP 以完全相同的方式对未分解的潜在变量 z z 进行池化，以此检验分解操作是否会移除参考人脸或场景信息。定性结果。 显著特征条件生成能够保留参考数字或眼镜类型的新人脸和场景，而 Raw DINOv3 GMP 几乎完全复制了参考人物或场景，且常常会改变数字（附录图 15）；图 3（右上角）展示了每个参考样本的若干示例。定量结果。 在 Digits-ImageNet 数据集上，显著特征条件将子类型准确率从 27.7 % 27.7\% 提升至 90.5 % 90.5\%，Vendi 指标从 2.65 提升至 12.50（真实值：15.79 15.79），同时将 Cos-to-ref 从 0.794 降至 0.116（表 2）。 在 FFHQ 数据集上，两种条件都能保留眼镜类型（96.6 % 96.6\% 对比 98.5 % 98.5\%），但只有显著特征条件能生成多样化的样本（Vendi：6.96 6.96 对比 2.32 2.32；Cos-to-ref：0.470 0.470 对比 0.779 0.779）。 由于两种条件仅在于显著特征编码器的不同，因此复制行为的减少表明 z_s z_{s} 是一种更具选择性的条件。 Raw DINOv3 GMP 的有条件 gFID 较低，这与它更倾向于复制参考样本而非控制子类型的表现一致；而 SAGE 在两个数据集上的无条件 gFID 均更低。

paragraphs.en: We presented SAGE, which learns salient factors in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder using only background/target labels. Its factors faithfully reconstruct and edit individual images. Without subtype labels, its salient representation recovers digits, eyewear types, and retinal diseases, reveals finer sunglasses styles and mislabeled images, and conditions the generation of new images that keep a discovered subtype while common content varies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SAGE，它仅使用背景/目标标签，就能在冻结表示自编码器的多维空间潜在空间中学习显著因素。 其提取的因素能够忠实地重建和编辑单张图像。 在没有亚型标签的情况下，其显著表示能够恢复数字、眼镜类型和视网膜疾病，揭示更精细的太阳镜款式和错误标记的图像，并能生成新的图像：这些图像在保留所发现的亚型的同时，允许常见内容发生变化。

paragraphs.en: We will release code, trained models, and the audited FFHQ labels upon publication. All experiments use public data: MNIST and ImageNet for Digits-ImageNet, FFHQ with the FFHQ Features eyewear annotations, and OCT-Kermany. Appendix B.1 describes how each dataset is built, including the Digits-ImageNet compositing, the audited FFHQ evaluation labels, and the OCT preprocessing and splits. Appendices C and D give the Stage 1 and Stage 2 architectures, objectives, optimization settings, and checkpoints, and Appendices B.2 and B.3 give the baseline configurations. paragraphs.en: Figure 11 looks inside the sunglasses subtype. Without labels for finer styles, SAGE’s salient representation splits sunglasses into three groups, from a compact C1 to a broader C2 and a smaller C3 at its lower end: C1 (Wayfarer-like) collects thick frames with angular or rectangular lenses; C2 (mixed styles) spans rounded, narrow, and sporty frames with varied lens tint; and C3 (Aviator-like) collects thin-rimmed, rounded or teardrop-shaped lenses, often reflective. The three groups share one coarse label yet differ in frame geometry and lens shape, showing that the salient factor captures appearance structure finer than the annotated subtypes.
paragraphs.zh: 图 11 展示了太阳镜这一子类型的内部结构。 在没有更精细风格标签的情况下，SAGE 的显著表示将太阳镜分为三组：从紧凑的 C1 到较宽泛的 C2，再到其下端较小的 C3。C1（类 Wayfarer）包含厚边框搭配棱角分明或矩形镜片的设计；C2（混合风格）涵盖圆形、窄框和运动风格的镜框，镜片色调也各不相同；而 C3（类 Aviator）则收集了细边框、圆形或水滴形镜片的设计，这些镜片通常具有反光效果。 这三组共享一个粗略标签，但在镜框几何形状和镜片形态上存在差异，这表明显著性因子能够比标注的子类型更精细地捕捉外观结构。

paragraphs.en: We preprocess scans in grayscale. First, we remove rows or columns that are at least 95% white (intensity ≥ 0.90 \geq 0.90 ) along their full extent. To preserve retinal tissue under oblique white wedges, we then replace only near-white regions connected to an image boundary and larger than 64 pixels, rather than rectangularly cropping to the deepest wedge. Replacement pixels are Gaussian noise matched to the mean and standard deviation of the darkest 40% of pixels in the scan, which correspond to the vitreous. Scans for which this replacement would cover over 60% of the image are retained unchanged. Finally, we preserve aspect ratio, bicubically resize to height 384, and center-crop to 384 × 384 384\times 384 before storing RGB images. This avoids the aspect-ratio distortions caused by directly resizing the eight native scan widths to a square. During representation learning, images are resized from 384 384 to 256 256 for DINOv3, without data augmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将扫描图像预处理为灰度图像。 首先，我们移除那些在整个范围内至少有 95% 是白色（强度 ≥ 0.90）的行或列。 为了保留斜向白色楔形区域下的视网膜组织，我们接着仅替换与图像边界相连且面积大于 64 像素的近白色区域，而不是按矩形方式裁剪至最深的楔形区域。 替换的像素是高斯噪声，其均值和标准差与扫描图像中最暗的 40% 像素（对应于玻璃体）相匹配。 如果这种替换会覆盖超过 60% 的图像，则保留原始扫描图像不变。 最后，我们保持宽高比，通过双三次插值将图像调整到高度为 384，然后中心裁剪至 384 × 384，再存储 RGB 图像。 这避免了直接将八种原始扫描宽度调整为正方形时产生的宽高比失真问题。 在表示学习过程中，图像从 384 × 384 调整到 256 × 256 以用于 DINOv3，且不加数据增强。

We additionally evaluate the unfactorized RAEv2 latent z z (DINOv3 with MLS), denoted DINOv3 in figures. paragraphs.en: DINOv3 + SepCLR shares SAGE’s frozen RAEv2 encoder (DINOv3-L with multi-layer summation and RAEv2 latent normalization) and common/salient encoder architecture, and differs in its objectives and evaluation readout (Table 9 ). Each branch applies global average pooling (GAP), following SepCLR, to obtain a 1,024-dimensional vector. A fully connected layer maps it to the 32-dimensional representation used for evaluation. A separate MLP projector ( → → BN → ReLU → 32 32\!\to\!128\!\to\!\mathrm{BN}\!\to\!\mathrm{ReLU}\!\to\!32 , with batch normalization, BN) supplies only the contrastive and k k -JEM losses; its output is not used for evaluation. Only the two common/salient Transformers, two fully connected layers, and two projectors are trained. We retain SepCLR’s alignment, uniformity, salient regularization, and JEM losses and its original loss hyperparameters ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: DINOv3 + SepCLR 共享 SAGE 的冻结 RAEv2 编码器（DINOv3-L，采用多层求和与 RAEv2 潜在归一化）以及通用/显著编码器架构，但其在目标函数和评估读取方式上有所不同（表 9）。 每个分支均遵循 SepCLR 的做法，应用全局平均池化（GAP），以获得一个 1,024 维向量。 一个全连接层将其映射为评估所用的 32 维表示。 一个独立的 MLP 投影器（→ → BN → ReLU → 32 32\!\to\!128\!\to\!\mathrm{BN}\!\to\!\mathrm{ReLU}\!\to\!32，带批量归一化 BN）仅提供对比损失和 k k -JEM 损失；其输出不用于评估。 仅对两个通用/显著 Transformer、两个全连接层和两个投影器进行训练。 我们保留了 SepCLR 的对齐性、均匀性、显著性正则化和 JEM 损失，以及其原始的损失超参数（Louiset et al., 2024）。

sents.en: We retain SepCLR’s alignment, uniformity, salient regularization, and JEM losses and its original loss hyperparameters ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: Figure C.1 illustrates the architecture used for the common and salient encoders, which map frozen RAE features to the two additive representations. paragraphs.en: For both FFHQ and Digits-ImageNet, we use four NVIDIA H200 GPUs with 32 images per GPU, giving a global batch size of 128 (approximately 64 background and 64 target images). The DINOv3 backbone and RAE decoder remain frozen, as does the discriminator’s feature-extraction backbone; only the common/salient encoders and discriminator heads are optimized.

paragraphs.en: We investigate how much a Stage-2 model varies its output under a fixed conditioning image as the initial noise changes by computing the Vendi Score ( Friedman and Dieng, 2023 ) from the eigenvalues of the CLS output of DINOv2-L ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) ( facebook/dinov2-large ). Diversity must be measured within a reference for non-target attribute variation to be visible: scored across a set spanning many references, the variation among the references themselves enters the number, and a model that copies each reference would appear diverse on inherited variation alone. We report these results in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过计算 DINOv2-L（Oquab et al., 2024）（facebook/dinov2-large）CLS 输出的特征值来得到 Vendi Score（Friedman and Dieng, 2023），以此研究在固定条件图像的情况下，Stage-2 模型在初始噪声变化时其输出会发生多大程度的变化。 多样性必须在参考范围内进行测量，这样才能观察到非目标属性的变化：当在一个包含多个参考的集合中进行评分时，参考本身的变化也会被纳入计算；如果模型只是复制每个参考，那么仅凭继承的变化就会显得具有多样性。 我们在表 2 中报告了这些结果。

paragraphs.en: We draw reference images by stratified random sampling from the target validation images. For FFHQ, we sample 30 images from each manually verified eyewear subtype—reading glasses and sunglasses—for 60 images total; for Digits-ImageNet, we sample 10 images for each digit class (100 images total). Each reference image is paired with K = 16 K=16 independently generated noise samples. SAGE and Raw DINOv3 GMP use the identical reference lists and initial noises, pairing generated samples image by image. SAGE pools the Stage 1 salient representations with global max pooling (GMP), whereas Raw DINOv3 GMP bypasses the salient encoder and pools the original Stage 1 DINOv3 features with GMP. The two Stage 2 models are trained separately with the same training budget.

paragraphs.en: SAGE inherits the representation and reconstruction priors of its frozen encoder and decoder, which are pretrained on natural images. Reconstruction on OCT-Kermany is accordingly less faithful than on natural images (SSIM 0.448 0.448 versus 0.571 0.571 on Digits-ImageNet and 0.723 0.723 on FFHQ; Table 6 ). Because SAGE keeps the autoencoder frozen, a representation autoencoder pretrained on biomedical images could replace RAEv2 without changing the method.
paragraphs.zh: SAGE 继承了其冻结的编码器和解码器的表示与重建先验，而这些组件是在自然图像上预训练的。 因此，在 OCT-Kermany 上的重建保真度低于在自然图像上的重建（SSIM 为 0.448 0.448，而在 Digits-ImageNet 上为 0.571 0.571，在 FFHQ 上为 0.723 0.723；见表 6）。 由于 SAGE 保持自编码器处于冻结状态，因此可以用在生物医学图像上预训练的表示自编码器来替代 RAEv2，而无需更改该方法。
